text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the opening day of the Mainichi Okan, an important step toward the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After I give her a bit of encouragement, El Condor Pasa declares she'll make a sweeping victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, her classmate Grass Wonder will also be running in the race, along with the peerless Silence Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matched against incredibly talented Umamusume, she heads to the race to prove herself worthy of the Japan Cup.
